changes.title: Agent Platform joins the public ecosystem surface
changes.summary: Agent Platform is now public and advertises its source, local service documentation, generated OpenAPI contract, dependencies, and first-run path through the shared b10x docs contract.

relations.label: Uses Harness for model and tool execution

changes.title: Connectors joins the public ecosystem surface
changes.summary: Connectors now exposes its catalog, architecture, adoption guides, dependencies, and current maturity through the shared b10x documentation contract.

relations.label: Supplies governed operations to Agent Platform

changes.title: Eventlog joins the public ecosystem surface
changes.summary: Eventlog now publishes its library boundary, crate layout, adoption path, and downstream role through the shared b10x documentation contract.

relations.label: Supplies durable workflow state and evidence

changes.title: Identity joins the public ecosystem surface
changes.summary: Identity now advertises its service boundary, local adoption path, API reference, dependencies, and deployment maturity through the shared b10x documentation contract.

changes.title: Agent interaction research joins public discovery
changes.summary: The reproducible interaction study now publishes its question, deterministic pipeline, adoption path, and relationship to agent guidance through the shared b10x documentation contract.

changes.title: Workflow joins the public ecosystem surface
changes.summary: Workflow now publishes its product-neutral boundary, current maturity, adoption path, and dependencies through the shared b10x documentation contract.

changes.title: Adoption and ecosystem changes become typed public contracts
changes.summary: Docs System 0.2.0 adds explicit first-run outcomes, repository-owned impact records, deterministic release enrichment, and RSS and JSON feeds.

changes.title: Agents gain shared workspace-hygiene guidance
changes.summary: Agent Plugins 0.3.0 adds the workspace-hygiene plugin and a Worktree-generated skill for consistent, recoverable checkout lifecycle across supported agents.

changes.title: Managed worktrees gain a reusable lifecycle toolchain
changes.summary: Worktree 0.1.0 publishes the embeddable lifecycle service, Git and SQLite adapters, CLI, hook protocol, and generated agent skill.

changes.title: AEP becomes the canonical protocol command
changes.summary: AEP 0.40.0 establishes aep as the authored command, retains protocol as an exact compatibility alias, and keeps ESS adaptation at one optional evidence boundary.

relations.label: Consumes only the closed ESS conformance report

changes.title: ESS becomes a standalone executable specification toolchain
changes.summary: ESS 0.1.0 extracts system modeling, schema contracts, generators, and conformance into an independent repository with no AEP dependency.
